description: Guard against the failure mode in bounded-agent-spawning.md memory: a workflow prompt asking for 'N items' must NOT spawn >N agents after the LLM overshoots. The original failure (2026-06-12, wf_65120278-a76): a '20-35 items' prompt overshot to ~44, audit+verify doubled to 105 total agents. The contract: code-side clamping before fan-out. This fixture checks that the workflow artifacts (commands/team-build.md, commands/team-plan.md, skills/orchestrate/) document the clamp contract — they must (a) reference a hard cap, (b) reference bounded-agent-spawning memory, (c) contain the explicit fan-out clamp pattern. If the documentation regresses, the lesson is gone and the next agent-spawn will overshoot again.

evals.task: Verify that the harness's workflow authoring artifacts (commands/team-build.md, commands/team-plan.md, skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md) document the bounded-spawning contract — a hard cap on agent fan-out, and a reference to the bounded-agent-spawning memory. Without this, the next LLM author will write a prompt that overshoots and the audit will repeat (2026-06-12, 105 agents).
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references bounded-agent-spawning
At least one of the checked files mentions a hard cap or bounded fan-out
At least one of the checked files contains the word fan-out
